s.note: the food truck that pulls up at lunchtime
s.how: Brown 500g beef mince with an onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and chilli. Warm 12 corn tortillas and fill with the beef, shredded lettuce, 100g grated cheddar and a spoon of salsa.

s.note: the burger stand down the road
s.how: Brown 300g beef mince with a chopped onion and chilli powder, add a drained tin of kidney beans and a splash of water and simmer 20 minutes. Fry 1kg thick chips twice. Spoon the chilli over, top with 150g cheddar and grill to melt.

m.note: lunch break at the car wash
m.how: Simmer 250g beef mince with 1 tsp cumin, chilli powder and 150ml water for 20 minutes until loose. Griddle 8 franks and put in steamed buns. Top with the chilli, yellow mustard, raw onion and sweet relish.

w.note: a scorching day on the job
w.how: Stir 2 tbsp sugar into 500ml fresh orange juice until dissolved. Drop a few frozen berries into each mould and pour the juice over. Push sticks in after an hour and freeze solid for 6 hours.

d.how: Fill four glasses with ice and a squeeze of lime. Pour a 375ml can of cola over each and drink it in the shade between cars.
